purpose: Teach: 群衆/語源/裏切っ/献血/くくっ/苑/龍/埋もれ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、駅前の群衆の安全を警察、確保しております
lines.en: We've secured the safety of the crowds in front of the station.
lines.style: Professional and steady. Clear, measured delivery. The confidence of someone stating established fact. No hurry. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、暗号の語源解析を進めております
lines.en: We're making progress analyzing the origins and meaning of the cipher.
lines.style: Bureaucratic precision. Each phrase lands with careful weight. Slight pause between thoughts. The tone of a report being delivered, not a conversation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、組織を裏切った内通者を警察、特定されたんですね
lines.en: So the police have identified the insider who betrayed the organization?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry with underlying intelligence. Thoughtful pace. Testing the waters of what he's allowed to understand. A question from someone working through the pieces.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者ご遺族のための献血支援も行います
lines.en: We're also providing blood donation support for the victim's family.
lines.style: Shift to gentler register. Still official, but the warmth underneath. Slight softening of pace. A human detail slipped into the procedural report.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人がくくった証拠物の縄、警察、回収されたんですね
lines.en: So the police recovered the rope that the perpetrator used to bind the evidence?
lines.style: Quiet, methodical. Drawing a conclusion from facts already laid out. Respectful pace—not rushing. The voice of someone piecing a story together carefully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、神苑近くの巡回を強化しております
lines.en: We've increased patrols around the shrine gardens.
lines.style: Return to procedural formality. Steady, matter-of-fact. The cadence of an official statement. No elaboration, just fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、龍頭の装飾品を警察、押収されたんですね
lines.en: So the police seized the ornamental dragon-head decoration?
lines.style: Careful, observant tone. Building understanding piece by piece. Slight hesitation—respectful of the gravity. Not performing, just working through it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、書類に埋もれた手がかりを見つけました
lines.en: We found the clue buried in the paperwork.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. A small moment of genuine discovery breaking through procedure. Slightly warmer, less formal. The tone of having solved something real.
